hook: All of Hyderabad's garbage, *8,000 tonnes a day*, goes to one site. Residents march *Oct 27*
tldr: Jawahar Nagar is the only dump yard for the whole city: about 8,000 tonnes of garbage a day on a 339-acre site. Malkajgiri MP Eatala Rajender wants fresh dumping stopped and old waste recycled; residents march on Oct 27 and environmentalist K. Purushotham Reddy joins on Oct 28.

beats.what: A roundtable at Begumpet demanded the dump be shifted and replaced with zero-pollution processing. An agitation starts Tuesday, Oct 27.
beats.why: Residents say they live with serious health risks, and court orders haven't been implemented.
beats.care: Every bag of garbage you throw out ends up here. If the protests block dumping, collection in your area can slow down.
